text:
Source-assisted selected reading of F-v0qx (pp. 865-868 of the copy). Pages 865 and 866 and the heads of pp. 867 and 868 were reread on the images by a research reader; in the bodies of pp. 867 and 868 only the passages marked (reread) were checked, the rest follows the image-only first reading. Letters in [ ] are lost between the pieces or unread; where filled, they are supplied from Matthaeus, Concionum dispositiones, Wittenberg 1581, part 2, pp. 408-412. (?) marks an uncertain reading. Boxes are native pixels x0,y0,x1,y1. / marks a line end.
